summary: A bare pale scrubbed pine planks countertop, concave L-shaped inside corner with a square transparent notch cut from the lower-right quarter; two equal-width perpendicular arms.
notes: Bare modular counter top. Standard counter depth: 40 map units. Rotate pieces in 90-degree increments and align their flat connector edges. Straight: 80 × 40; inner corner: 80 × 80; outer corner: 40 × 40; end: 60 × 40. No props are attached.
